mapper.select: SELECT id, law_code AS lawCode, article_no AS articleNo, content, MATCH(content) AGAINST (#{kw}) AS score FROM law_item WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (#{kw}) AND status = 'active' AND (expire_date IS NULL OR expire_date > CURRENT_DATE) ORDER BY score DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM law_item WHERE status = 'active' AND is_enabled = 1
AND law_code = #{lawCode}
